name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
Major upgrade since v1.9.4

🎨 Native Ring UI Design — All buttons, inputs, tables, checkboxes, date pickers, and tabs now use JetBrains Ring UI components. The plugin looks and feels like a native part of YouTrack.

↕ Sort by Assignee — Click the Assignee column header in Planning view to sort by team member and see everyone's workload at a glance.

📋 Complete Sprint History — Sprint snapshots now capture all tasks regardless of status (In Progress, Done, Cancelled — not just Planned). Your history tells the full story.

💬 Polished Modals & Notifications — Consistent focus management, ARIA accessibility, backdrop support, and a clean bottom-right toast notification stack across all 18 dialogs.

🌍 Fully Localized — 50+ new UI strings across all 13 supported languages covering role labels, standup assistant, and sprint goal fields.

🐛 Reliability Fixes — Correct assignee sort order, fixed history table column layout, group permission hierarchy lookup, and several modal positioning edge cases.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
